Step: Create a new part and edit an existing part
Expected Result: Part is created and saved; edits persist; changes are audited (config log)

Precondition: An item open in Item Master
Expected Result: Part number, description, units of measure, and related master-data fields are present and editable

Precondition: An item open in Item Master

Expected Result: Entry is flagged/blocked as unreasonable per the part's Max LOT Size

Precondition: Config Tool open at Item Master

Expected Result: Item type is stored and constrains downstream routing/area eligibility
